question: Which quarter of 2025 had the highest industry net income?

final_answer.explanation: I summed each bank's quarterly net income (current-quarter YTD minus prior-quarter YTD within 2025, with Q1 taken as YTD) across all filers. Industry net income was about $70.9B in Q1, $70.5B in Q2, $79.9B in Q3 and $78.4B in Q4, so 2025Q3 is the highest. WITH f AS (
  SELECT CERT, REPDTE, NETINC,
         CAST(REPDTE/10000 AS INT) AS yr,
         CAST((REPDTE%10000)/100 AS INT) AS mo
  FROM raw_financials
  WHERE REPDTE BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
),
q AS (
  SELECT cur.CERT, cur.REPDTE, cur.mo, cur.NETINC AS ytd,
         prev.NETINC AS prev_ytd, prev.CERT AS prev_cert
  FROM f cur
  LEFT JOIN f prev ON prev.CERT = cur.CERT AND prev.yr = cur.yr AND prev.mo = cur.mo - 3
),
qq AS (
  SELECT REPDTE, mo,
    CASE WHEN mo = 3 THEN ytd
         WHEN prev_cert IS NULL THEN ytd
         ELSE ytd - prev_ytd END AS q_ni,
    CASE WHEN mo = 3 THEN ytd
         WHEN prev_cert IS NULL THEN 0

  FROM q
)

  SUM(q_ni)/1e6 AS q_ni_billions,
  SUM(q_ni_zero)/1e6 AS q_ni_zero_billions,
  COUNT(*) AS banks
FROM qq

q AS (
  SELECT f.*, i.NAME, i.RSSDHCR

  LEFT JOIN raw_institutions i ON f.CERT = i.CERT
  WHERE f.REPDTE = 20260630

GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY assets_k DESC
LIMIT 10
